Who We Are

Working with people, for people.

Hatteshwar Pratishthan is a community-focused social organisation. The website can present the Pratishthan's programmes, initiatives, impact, volunteer opportunities and public information in a clear and transparent way.

Our approach: local participation, practical action and long-term community development.

🌱 Our Vision

To contribute to an inclusive and empowered society where people can access opportunities, support and a better quality of life.

🎯 Our Mission

To undertake meaningful initiatives in education, empowerment, social welfare, community development and other areas that benefit society.
